English: Ale Bench
A simple, rough-hewn bench placed around a fire, where warriors gather to share ale and tales after a days ride.
Wooden Gathering Hut
A modest timber hut, hastily built for clan councils, drinking, and shelter from the harsh northern winds.
Feast Room
A spacious room of timber and packed earth, where the clan holds their feasts, strengthening bonds and morale.
Storytellers Alcove
A cozy alcove lined with furs and benches, reserved for skalds and wise elders to recount the sagas and histories of the clan.
Timbered Mead Hall
A robust longhouse of seasoned timber, boasting high beams and great hearths, where the clan gathers in strength and unity.
Skalds Platform
A raised stage within the hall, adorned with carved runes, where the greatest skalds inspire the clan with words and song.
Bannered Hall
A mighty hall adorned with the banners of the clans victories, a rallying point that inspires unity and martial pride among all gathered.
Great Drinking Room
An expansive chamber ringed with carved tables, endless barrels of mead, and space for the entire clan to feast, plot, and strengthen their blood-bonds.
Chieftains Longhouse
The seat of the chieftain, this monumental longhouse is a testament to the clans might, with carved pillars and a high seat for the ruler.
Royal Mead Hall
A legendary hall whose fame echoes across the north. Here, the king holds court, hosts legendary feasts, and unites the clans under a single banner.
